annotations.title: Change, pause or resume a repeating wake-up

description: Change a repeating wake-up (repeat, time_zone, target, payload, alert inbox, name: the same checks as creating it; its history stays), or pause it ("paused": waiting runs are canceled) or resume it ("active": from the next time after now).

alert_inbox_instance_id.description: One of your inboxes for missed-run messages, or null for the target inbox.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

payload.description: New JSON sent with every run (up to 8 KB).

minutes.description: Minutes on the UTC clock: an N that divides a day (5, 15, 60, 1440) runs from 00:00 UTC.

minute.description: Every hour at this minute (0 to 59) of time_zone's clock.

at.description: Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.
Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.

schedule_id.description: schedule id (wsc_...) from schedule_create or schedule_list.

status.description: paused: stop it; active: run it again.

url.description: A public https URL we POST to.

time_zone.description: New IANA time zone, for example Europe/Istanbul. Left out: the current one stays.

name: schedule_update
title: Change, pause or resume a repeating wake-up
